name: Elaim
description: Elaim is a quiet, dedicated elf apprentice who assists Tally Fellbranch at The Bent Nail on Trollskull Alley. Possessing steady hands, infinite patience, and a deep appreciation for fine wood grain, he handles delicate joinery, wood polishing, and intricate inlay work under Tally's mentorship.
ideals: Precision: 'A well-fitted joint needs no iron nails to hold it together.'
Dedication: 'There is quiet honor in turning rough timber into something enduring and beautiful.'
bonds: The Bent Nail and his mentor, Tally Fellbranch.
The woodworking craft and the tools he maintains with meticulous care.
flaws: Reserved and soft-spoken, often reluctant to speak up or interrupt when others are talking.
speech_patterns: Soft, measured, and concise, choosing his words carefully and focusing heavily on technical details of craftsmanship.
mannerisms: Carefully sweeps up wood shavings, tests the smoothness of a sanded surface with his fingertips, and listens intently with a gentle nod.
motivations: To master the art of fine woodworking and become a master craftsman in his own right.
knowledge: Wood types, fine joinery techniques, sanding and finishing processes, and daily workshop maintenance.
gm_notes: Elaim serves as a quiet, helpful fixture at The Bent Nail. He can assist the party with minor wood repairs, relay messages for Tally, or offer a grounded, calm perspective on neighborhood happenings along Trollskull Alley.
